content: Tailwind CSS v3 includes grid-cols-1 through grid-cols-12 by default. Tailwind v4 (used in this project) uses CSS-first config via @theme in CSS. In v4, grid-cols-7 is still generated by default as part of the grid utilities. If not available, use arbitrary value: grid-cols-[repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr))] — note v4 syntax uses underscores not commas in arbitrary values. For a 7-column calendar grid: 'grid grid-cols-7 gap-px' on container, each day column gets a bg-white cell. Today column highlighted with different bg/border. Overflow: at narrow desktop (< 7 * minWidth per column), add 'overflow-x-auto' with min-width on columns. Tailwind responsive prefix 'md:grid' to show only on desktop, 'md:hidden' to hide on mobile.
